title: Bring this repository's agents template up to date with its generated file
description: This repository's CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md has been edited beyond what CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md renders: it has a Right-now WIP (kbs now) section, a longer agent provenance section, wiki commands and agent command examples the template lacks. Running kbs setup agents --force today drops that content, so the methodologies change does not regenerate the file. Fold the extra content into the template (or the built-in core template where it is general), then regenerate CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md from methodologies. Also note kbs setup agents --force replaces everything under the Kanbus heading in AGENTS.md, which here deletes project-specific console notes.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Folded the Right-now WIP section and the full agent provenance reference into CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md, then regenerated CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md from the methodologies. The regenerated file also picks up the BDD, Git Flow and Hello World guidance and the event type that the old hand-edited copy lacked. AGENTS.md was deliberately not regenerated: kbs setup agents --force still replaces the Kanbus heading there and would delete project-specific console notes.
